scenes.title: A changed field becomes a location

vo.text: How does the glass know where your finger landed?
vo.speak: How does the glass know where your finger landed?

vo.text: Beneath it, transparent electrodes cross in rows and columns.
vo.speak: Beneath it, transparent electrodes cross in rows and columns.

vo.text: Each crossing holds a tiny electric field.
vo.speak: Each crossing holds a tiny electric field.

vo.text: Your finger draws a little charge, so this field changes.
vo.speak: Your finger draws a little charge, so this field changes.

vo.text: The other crossings stay nearly unchanged.
vo.speak: The other crossings stay nearly unchanged.

vo.text: The controller finds the changed row and column.
vo.speak: The controller finds the changed row and column.

vo.text: Their intersection becomes the touch position.
vo.speak: Their intersection becomes the touch position.

vo.text: A normal glove stops this effect.
vo.speak: A normal glove stops this effect.

vo.text: Conductive thread lets it through, so the crossing responds again.
vo.speak: Conductive thread lets it through, so the crossing responds again.

vo.text: That is how glass turns a changed electric field into a touch location.
vo.speak: That is how glass turns a changed electric field into a touch location.
